Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog:
- Use the hosted XIV.fm test server by default; no manual Development server URL or toggle is required.
- Automatically migrate existing hosted-server credentials and legacy endpoint settings.
- Hide Diagnostics and development-server controls during normal use; enter `/xivfm dev` to reveal them for the current session.
